title.en: An Act Appropriating Funds for Public Works
title.orig: An Act Amending a Certain Item of Republic Act Numbered Twenty-Three Hundred and One, Entitled “An Act Appropriating Funds for Public Works”

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 2 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1960/ra_2857_1960.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en:
On page 588 of Republic Act Numbered Twenty-three hundred and one, item No. 5, under "Miscellaneous," of Section two, entitled "Projects under maintenance and short-term program of capital improvements," is hereby amended to read as follows:
"5. Zamboanguita: (a) Mayabon River Control ₱15,000.00."

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved: June 19, 1960.
